sentences.en: You have to encode the data before you send it.
sentences.zh: 你必须在发送数据之前对其进行编码。

sentences.en: Make sure you encode that file in the right format.
sentences.zh: 确保将文件以正确的格式进行编码。

sentences.en: All conversation involves the encoding and decoding of information.
sentences.zh: 所有的对话都涉及到信息的编码和解码过程。

senses.zh: （将文字材料）译成密码；编码，编制成计算机语言

mnemonic: 词根记忆：en（使…）+code（电码，密码）→编码
